name: rx-compose
check: cd ../Services/reencoder && docker compose config --format json > /tmp/rx-cc.json && python3 -c "import json,sys;s=json.load(open('/tmp/rx-cc.json'))['services']['reencoder'];v={x['target']:x.get('read_only',False) for x in s['volumes']};e=s['environment'];errs=[m for m,ok in [('media not ro',all(v[p] for p in v if p.startswith('/media'))),('mode',e.get('RX_MODE')=='report'),('mem',s.get('mem_limit') in (3221225472,'3221225472','3g')),('cpus',float(s.get('cpus',0))==4),('ports',not s.get('ports')),('dev','/dev/dri/renderD128' in str(s.get('devices'))),('user',s.get('user')=='1000:1000')] if not ok];print(errs);sys.exit(1 if errs else 0)"
